 * @param {number} size The number of items per page.
 * @param {Array<Object>} data The full dataset.

function paginate(page, size, data) {
  // Validate page and size: must be positive integers
  if (!Number.isInteger(page) || page <= 0 || !Number.isInteger(size) || size <= 0) {
    return [];

    return [];
  }

}
